explication: This repository is a Next.js App Router developer portfolio. The root layout establishes shared navigation, footer, styling, toast notifications, metadata, and optional Google Tag Manager; the homepage composes data-driven profile, experience, skills, projects, education, blog, and contact sections. Portfolio content is kept in `utils/data`, while server-rendered pages consume that configuration directly. The blog page fetches the author’s public articles from dev.to. Contact submission is a distinct server workflow: the client form posts to the contact route, which sends notifications through Telegram and Gmail SMTP. A separate route verifies reCAPTCHA tokens with Google. The map emphasizes these runtime flows and the main presentation subsystems. Some homepage composition and the contact form implementation were not included in the sampled source, so those relationships are based on repository structure and documented behavior rather than direct call-site evidence.
